news.headline: Shriram Finance Q2 profit jumps 59% YoY to Rs 3,677 crore on  strong interest income, lower funding costs
news.summary: Shriram Finance reported a 59.4% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 3,677 crore, driven by higher net interest income and lower funding costs. Assets under management grew 17%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 6.50 per share.

news.headline: Infosys ADRs crash 6% after Q2 results as revenue guidance cut spooks investors
news.summary: Infosys ADRs fell 6.3% after the company lowered FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1-2%, despite September-quarter revenue beating estimates. Profit missed expectations, while large deal wins and AI revenue growth offered support amid cautious technology spending.

news.headline: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance
news.summary: Infosys Q2 Results: IT services major Infosys Ltd on Friday reported 6% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,823 crore in the second quarter. The same stood at Rs 7,364 crore in the year-ago period. The company has trimmed its revenue growth guidance to 1-2% in constant currency for FY27 as against 1.5-3% given earlier.

news.headline: IndusInd Bank Q2 Results: Lender posts profit of Rs 1,176 crore vs Rs 445 crore loss a year ago
news.summary: In the second quarter of this fiscal year, IndusInd Bank reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,176 crore, showcasing a remarkable turnaround from a loss of Rs 445 crore in the same quarter last year. The bank's net interest income increased by 4% year-on-year to Rs 4,569 crore, driven by enhanced asset quality, while gross non-performing assets decreased to 2.73% of gross advances, indicating robust profitability and growth momentum.

news.headline: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: Co swings to black with  Rs 1,254 crore profit; revenue jumps 37% YoY
news.summary: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: The improvement in profitability was driven by lower mark-to-market losses on investments in Tata Capital Ltd. The company reported a strong net cash position of Rs 15,900 crore as of September 30, 2026.

news.headline: Infosys Q2 Results Live Updates: Infosys Q2 net profit jumps 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore, revenue rises 11%; co declares interim dividend of Rs 26/sh
Infosys shares jump 3% ahead of Q2 earnings announcement. What to expect?
news.summary: Infosys shares rose on Friday ahead of the IT major’s Q2 FY27 results, with analysts expecting an 11% year-on-year rise in revenue and an 8% increase in net profit. Investors will track management commentary on client spending, large deal wins and AI-led pricing pressure, alongside the company’s full-year revenue growth guidance.

news.headline: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
news.summary: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in mark-to-market losses.

news.headline: Jana Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 127%, raises FY27 growth outlook
news.summary: Jana Small Finance Bank reported a 127% year-on-year rise in Q2 profit to Rs 170 crore, supported by business growth, higher margins and improved gross asset quality. The bank raised its annual profit growth guidance to 100%, while loans and deposits expanded.

news.headline: RBI does not target any specific Rupee level, focuses on curbing volatility, says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
news.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

news.headline: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 913 crore, revenue declines marginally
news.summary: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 913.4 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue slipped 1.5%. North America weakness pressured performance, offset partly by growth in India and emerging markets, alongside biosimilar approvals and strategic partnerships.

news.headline: Global Market: Eurozone bond markets stabilise after volatile week
news.summary: Eurozone government bonds stabilised after a volatile week as investors balanced sovereign debt concerns against safe-haven demand amid uncertainty over AI investments and global growth. French borrowing costs remain under pressure ahead of key central bank policy decisions.

news.headline: Adani Power Q2 Results: Profit zooms 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore; revenue jumps 45%
news.summary: Adani Power has reported an impressive consolidated net profit of Rs 6,919 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which marks a striking 134% increase from last year's profit of Rs 2,953 crore during the same period. Additionally, their operational revenue surged to Rs 19,439 crore, representing a 45% growth from Rs 13,457 crore the previous year.

news.headline: Sterlite Technologies Q2 Results: Profit surges 12,817% YoY to Rs 517 crore, revenue jumps 145%
news.summary: Sterlite Technologies reported a 12,817% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 517 crore, while revenue surged 145% to a record Rs 2,529 crore. Strong demand for AI-ready digital infrastructure, improved margins and a one-time tariff refund gain supported performance, as its open order book reached Rs 35,274 crore.

news.headline: Safe-haven demand pushes Japan’s 10-year yield to two-month low
news.summary: Japanese government bonds saw a rally on Friday, leading to the benchmark 10-year yield hitting a two-month low. This surge occurred in response to a global selloff in tech stocks, prompting investors to flock to safer investment options. The approaching Bank of Japan policy meeting is the center of attention as market watchers analyze the implications for inflation and possible interest rate shifts.
